name: Matsubara Kasumi
source:
A married woman who is having an affair with the main character, Ryoji Matsubara. She is in her mid-30s.

She is often seen as younger than her age. To enjoy a trip alone with the main character, she pretended that she was going on a trip with a friend.

She has a daughter who is about to take an entrance exam, she's still quite young.

[From [url=http://plum.sakura.ne.jp/~tabito/g_hp7/game06.html]official site[/url]]
